children: U.S. regional bank swung to net loss in Q3, driven by credit loss provision
Net interest income rose from prior quarter on higher loan yields and lower deposit costs
Company incurred $1.2 mln in merger-related expenses ahead of planned HomeTrust merger
Blue Ridge Bankshares expects the HomeTrust merger to close in Q1 2027, pending approvals
CREDIT LOSS PROVISIONS - Co said net loss was mainly due to provision needs for out-of-market loans originated prior to 2024
HIGHER LOAN YIELDS - Net interest income increased on higher yields and average balances of loans held for investment
LOWER DEPOSIT COSTS - Decline in interest expense reflected reduce1d balances of higher-cost brokered deposits
